misconceptions.description: Multiplies the mass in grams by Avogadro's number instead of the number of moles.
misconceptions.remediation: Number of particles = (mass / molar mass) × Nₐ. Always convert grams to moles first.

misconceptions.description: Counts atoms when the question asks for molecules (or vice versa).
misconceptions.remediation: Underline what is asked: molecules, atoms, or ions. One H₂O molecule has 3 atoms.

misconceptions.description: Counts electrons for a whole shell when a subshell (fixed l) is specified.
misconceptions.remediation: n fixes the shell; l fixes the subshell. A subshell holds 2(2l + 1) electrons; a shell holds 2n².

misconceptions.description: Ignores water's own H⁺ for very dilute acids, giving pH > 7 for an acid.
misconceptions.remediation: An acid solution can never be basic. When [acid] ≲ 10⁻⁶ M, add water's contribution: solve [H⁺]² − c[H⁺] − Kw = 0.

misconceptions.description: Predicts shape from the number of bonded atoms only, ignoring lone pairs.
misconceptions.remediation: Count all electron domains (bond pairs + lone pairs) to get the electron geometry, then name the shape from atom positions only.

misconceptions.description: Gives the electron-pair geometry instead of the molecular shape.
misconceptions.remediation: Electron geometry includes lone pairs; molecular shape describes atoms only. XeF₄ has octahedral electron geometry but a square-planar shape.

misconceptions.description: Believes less substituted carbocations are more stable.
misconceptions.remediation: Alkyl groups donate electron density (+I effect and hyperconjugation), stabilising the positive charge. Stability: 3° > 2° > 1° > methyl.

misconceptions.description: Thinks every exothermic reaction is spontaneous at all temperatures.
misconceptions.remediation: Spontaneity depends on ΔG = ΔH − TΔS. If ΔS < 0, the −TΔS term is positive and grows with T, so an exothermic reaction can become non-spontaneous at high T.
